acceptance: Each idiom has generator tests; generic parts execute on duckdb, ClickHouse parts on chdb or a container; engines not obtainable are recorded as gaps.
Output differences versus the existing BenchBox regexes over their unit-test inputs are listed in the PR.
Fork make check, make benchbox-dist and make benchbox-check pass; PR merged.
description: BenchBox rewrites TPC-DI SQLite idioms (JULIANDAY, DATE('now'), DATE +/- INTERVAL, = 1/0 flag columns) with regexes for BigQuery, Databricks, ClickHouse and DataFusion (cloud_shared.py, core/tpcdi/benchmark.py), and ClickBench Snowflake regex-group escaping is a string replace. Move the idiom conversions into the fork's generators; the flag-column list is passed as an argument. Query ids and benchmark names must not appear in the fork.
